end.summary:
Discussed Diwali, Baisakhi, Bihu, and Pongal as festivals across India.
Explored the meaning of “harvest,” “region,” and crops becoming ready.
Kavya answered that crops are ready when they ripen, but continued to say festivals can happen at any time.
The link between harvest festivals, farming, seasons, and festival timing was not established; teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised connecting harvest festivals with the time when crops are ready, using examples such as Pongal, Baisakhi, and Bihu. Kavya identified that crops are ready when they ripen, but the mix-up that festival dates are unrelated to farming was not corrected by the end. At home, you can look at a simple India map or calendar and discuss one harvest festival, asking, “What crop or harvest is being celebrated, and when is it ready?”
